cards.front: How many sides and vertices does a triangle have?
cards.back: 3 sides and 3 vertices.
cards.say: How many sides and vertices does a triangle have? Three sides and three vertices.

cards.front: What is a quadrilateral?
cards.back: A shape with 4 straight sides. Squares, rectangles and kites are all quadrilaterals.
cards.say: What is a quadrilateral? A shape with four straight sides. Squares, rectangles and kites are all quadrilaterals.

cards.front: How many sides does a pentagon have?
cards.back: 5 sides.
cards.say: How many sides does a pentagon have? Five sides.

cards.front: How many sides does a hexagon have?
cards.back: 6 sides. A honeycomb cell is a hexagon.
cards.say: How many sides does a hexagon have? Six sides. A honeycomb cell is a hexagon.

cards.front: How many sides does an octagon have?
cards.back: 8 sides. A stop sign is an octagon.
cards.say: How many sides does an octagon have? Eight sides. A stop sign is an octagon.

cards.front: What is a vertex?
cards.back:
A corner of a shape, where sides or edges meet.
More than one are called vertices.
cards.say: What is a vertex? A corner of a shape, where sides or edges meet. More than one are called vertices.

cards.front: What is a right angle?
cards.back: A square corner, like the corner of a book. It is a quarter turn.
cards.say: What is a right angle? A square corner, like the corner of a book. It is a quarter turn.

cards.front: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
cards.back: 4 right angles.
cards.say: How many right angles does a rectangle have? Four right angles.

cards.front: How many equal sides does a square have?
cards.back: 4 equal sides. A square also has 4 right angles.
cards.say: How many equal sides does a square have? Four equal sides. A square also has four right angles.

cards.front: What is true about the opposite sides of a rectangle?
cards.back: They are the same length.
cards.say: What is true about the opposite sides of a rectangle? They are the same length.

cards.front: What is a line of symmetry?
cards.back: A line that cuts a shape into two halves that match exactly, like a mirror.
cards.say: What is a line of symmetry? A line that cuts a shape into two halves that match exactly, like a mirror.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
cards.back: 4 lines of symmetry.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does a square have? Four lines of symmetry.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (not a square) have?
cards.back: 2 lines of symmetry. One goes across and one goes down the middle.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle that is not a square have? Two lines of symmetry. One goes across and one goes down the middle.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
cards.back: 3 lines of symmetry, because all 3 sides are equal.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have? Three lines of symmetry, because all three sides are equal.

cards.front: Does the letter M have a vertical line of symmetry?
cards.back: Yes. The left half is a mirror of the right half.
cards.say: Does the letter M have a vertical line of symmetry? Yes. The left half is a mirror of the right half.

cards.front: Does the letter F have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: No. You cannot fold it so that both halves match.
cards.say: Does the letter F have a line of symmetry? No. You cannot fold it so that both halves match.

cards.front: Which letter has both a vertical and a horizontal line of symmetry: H or A?
cards.back:
H
A has only a vertical line of symmetry.
cards.say: Which letter has both a vertical and a horizontal line of symmetry: H or A? H. A has only a vertical line of symmetry.

cards.front: What is an edge on a 3D shape?
cards.back: A straight line where two faces meet.
cards.say: What is an edge on a three D shape? A straight line where two faces meet.

cards.front: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cube have?
cards.back: 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
cards.say: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cube have? Six faces, twelve edges and eight vertices.

cards.front: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cuboid have?
cards.back: 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A tissue box is a cuboid.
cards.say: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cuboid have? Six faces, twelve edges and eight vertices. A tissue box is a cuboid.

cards.front: Describe a cylinder.
cards.back: 2 flat faces that are circles and 1 curved surface. A tin can is a cylinder.
cards.say: Describe a cylinder. Two flat faces that are circles and one curved surface. A tin can is a cylinder.

cards.front: Describe a sphere.
cards.back: No flat faces, no edges and no vertices. A ball is a sphere.
cards.say: Describe a sphere. No flat faces, no edges and no vertices. A ball is a sphere.

cards.front: Describe a cone.
cards.back: 1 flat face that is a circle, 1 curved surface and 1 vertex.
cards.say: Describe a cone. One flat face that is a circle, one curved surface and one vertex.

cards.front: How many faces, edges and vertices does a square-based pyramid have?
cards.back: 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices.
cards.say: How many faces, edges and vertices does a square-based pyramid have? Five faces, eight edges and five vertices.

cards.front: How many faces, edges and vertices does a triangular prism have?
cards.back: 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices.
cards.say: How many faces, edges and vertices does a triangular prism have? Five faces, nine edges and six vertices.
